SELECT s.SOCType, s.StatusType, COUNT(*) AS schools, COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS matched, COUNT(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)") AS reported, SUM(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)") AS eligible
FROM main.schools AS s
LEFT JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.SOCType LIKE '%Youth%'
GROUP BY s.SOCType, s.StatusType
